name: runtime-audio-capture
goal: A verification captures the exact hash-checked bytes of the clip the page plays, under the unchanged renderer policy

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Verification only: runtimeAudio fetched audio.currentSrc, an object URL. The compiled renderer's policy has media-src blob: and connect-src 'self', so the clip plays and the fetch is blocked; ordinary runs skip the capture. Expected: the played clip's exact bytes are kept, policy unchanged. Cause confirmed in work/runtime-evidence-review/audio-capture-repair/csp-diagnostic/result.json

steps.title: Write and run a failing regression test; record the defect assertion and command.
steps.evidence: Unchanged tree f6266e3, build stamped c82e7b75 by build:desktop and verify stamp. HARNESS_VERIFY=1 TAKE_SCREENSHOT=1 bunx playwright test ui-evidence-behavior.spec.ts: 4 passed, 1 failed at runtime-evidence.ts:84, TypeError: Failed to fetch; console: connecting to blob: violates connect-src 'self'. No audio, no audio-commit screenshot (work/runtime-evidence-review/audio-capture-repair/red-unchanged)

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: ui-evidence-fixture.ts keeps the object behind each URL the page makes; evidencePlayed reads the played object's bytes, recordedClip names the sealed history's hash. runtime-evidence.ts keeps the bytes only when their SHA-256 is that hash. No fetch; spec, assertions, capture line, product source and policy unchanged

steps.title: Repeat repair and the same unchanged regression test until it passes; record passing proof.
steps.evidence: Same command on the same stamped build: 5 passed; runtime-silent-fixture.wav 8044 bytes, sha256 dd9165ab, equal to the recorded clip; PCM 8-bit mono 8 kHz, every sample 128. The four scenario commands: 23 passed, 27 of 27 required captures, all with build c82e7b75 and revision f6266e3 (work/runtime-evidence-review/audio-capture-repair/green-direct, green-scenario). Tree had the uncommitted test edits

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots; keep pending until proof passes.
Prove that wrong or unrelated bytes are never kept as the clip.
steps.evidence: Throwaway copy. M1, hash check removed: runtime-evidence-capture.test.ts fails, damaged, cut, picture and empty bytes would be kept. M2, the capture handed 8044 unrelated audio-typed bytes in the real verification run: test 5 fails with 'does not have the recorded SHA-256', no audio recorded. Repaired tree: unit 6 passed (work/runtime-evidence-review/audio-capture-repair/mutants)
